line_name: صندوق تنمية المواصلات وتكنولوجيات المعلومات والإتصال (telecommunications and ICT development fund, special treasury account)
purpose: The ICT fund, the special treasury account through which the communication-technologies mission finances telecom infrastructure, e-government projects and grants to the sector's agencies.
scope_basis: A levy-financed account whose whole purpose is telecommunications and ICT development; in 2024 every line it funded was a digital-sector line.
doc_locator: Finance law 2026, table 'ب' receipts and expenditure of special treasury accounts, mission Communication Technologies, PDF p.33 (JORT p.4263)
notes: Read from the enacted finance law (Loi 2025-17, JORT n. 148 of 12 December 2025); its tables are scanned images and were read off the rendered page. No mission budget note or budget report is held for this year, so programme grain is the ceiling. The account's spending sits inside the digital development programme, whose payment credits are 161,335,000 (table 'ت'); the rest of that programme mixes general-budget and external-loan money that the law does not split, so it is not held. Account receipts are earmarked levies and fees, not appropriations.

admin_head: مهمة رئاسة الحكومة (Presidency of the Government)
programme: تحديث الخدمات الإدارية (Modernisation of administrative services)
line_name: برنامج عدد 5: تحديث الخدمات الإدارية (Programme 5: modernisation of administrative services)
purpose: The Prime Ministry's programme for administrative-service quality, procedural simplification and e-administration, including the e-administration unit.
scope_basis: In the 2024 note the programme's e-administration activity (the e-administration unit's wages) sits beside service-quality and simplification activities in one programme; the law prints the programme total only.
doc_locator: Finance law 2026, table 'ت' state budget expenditure, payment credits, mission 4 Presidency of the Government, programme 5, JORT p.4264
notes: Read from the enacted finance law (Loi 2025-17, JORT n. 148 of 12 December 2025); its tables are scanned images and were read off the rendered page. No mission budget note or budget report is held for this year, so programme grain is the ceiling. Mission total 284,500,000, which its six programmes sum to. In 2024 all of the programme's money was general-budget resources.
